about: C3b look development (not a proof): the wreck's checkpoint, E out of the car by real input, the eye turned onto him, his line and his arm down the river road. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_out_look.json

steps.eval: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase, m = C.manAt, K = G.controller; const dx = K.pos.x - m.x, dz = K.pos.z - m.z, L = Math.hypot(dx, dz); K.pos.x = m.x + dx / L * 2.4; K.pos.z = m.z + dz / L * 2.4; K.yaw = Math.atan2(-(m.x - K.pos.x), -(m.z - K.pos.z)); K.pitch = -0.3; return JSON.stringify({ man: m, eye: [K.pos.x, K.pos.z] }); })()
